title: Protocol for purification and enzymatic characterization of members of the human macrophage migration inhibitory factor superfamily
protocol: Dilute D-DT to 3.75 μM and MIF to 0.75 μM with their respective lysis buffers.
Make dilutions of the 4-HPP solution ranging from 0-30 mM.
Pipette 10 μL of the substrate solution into each well.
Pipette 10 μL of the desired protein solution into a column of the prepared reaction plate.
Take readings every 10 seconds for a total of 180 seconds (for MIF) or 300 seconds (for D-DT).
Repeat steps a-c for all desired replicates/experimental groups.
Test each experimental group in triplicate.
